purpose: Manual persistent Grafana panel JSON composer, bundled reference catalogs and optional propose-only Helix drafter. The inspected route is not an embedded Grafana dashboard or proxy viewer.
primaryGoal: Write or explicitly apply a proposed panel envelope, review its reference metadata, then copy JSON for manual paste into the user's existing Grafana editor without an automatic push.

dataSources.name: User-owned manual JSON
dataSources.behavior: Restore ai.grafanaPanel.draft verbatim; persist every truthy string including whitespace; remove key on empty string. Storage exceptions are swallowed. Copy trims without rewriting the draft. Manual text is not parsed or SQL-executed.

dataSources.name: Bundled catalog and derived summary
dataSources.owner: Page constants; parallel whitelist owner internal\api\ainlgrafana\handler.go
dataSources.behavior: 8 panel types, 2 datasource types, 5 tables, 33 documented columns. Counts are reference metadata, never fleet statistics, connected datasource checks or actual database row counts. Sorted names use localeCompare; column order is retained.
dataSources.limits: Backend calls UIDs placeholders to be adjusted by the user and accepts nonempty UIDs. Table existence, deployed schema, Grafana compatibility and connectivity are unverified.

dataSources.name: AI draft stream
dataSources.behavior: Bare route receives canonical API prefix; body {prompt: trimmedPrompt}; stream uses existing authHeaders/serverCredentials/AbortController. Capture successful draft_grafana_panel tool_result separately. Starting a new draft clears the old candidate. Applying is explicit and blocked while streaming; no browser push to Grafana.
dataSources.shape: GrafanaPanelDraft {prompt, panel:{title,type,datasource:{type,uid},targets:[{ref_id,raw_sql?,expr?,format?}],grid_pos:{x,y,w,h}},rationale,referenced_tables}. Parser filters malformed targets rather than rejecting the whole array and checks numeric grid types, not finiteness.
dataSources.limits: Route binding is source-verified only. No provider, SSE, guard, validator, database or Grafana endpoint exercised.

dataSources.name: AI settings and presentation preferences
dataSources.behavior: Existing settings key ['settings'], five-minute stale time, refetchOnMount always, retry 1. AI defaults off and nl-grafana-panel must be exactly true. Missing settings keep manual workflow available. Summary formatter retains preferences; no page settings writes.

components.name: PageLayout / Grid
components.contract: Existing PageContainer/shell, full-width min-w-0 adapter, one column then three at xl. Preserve shell ownership; no second page width or workspace selector engine.

components.name: OperationalBrief / useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: Four raw count metrics with source descriptions, neutral Static reference status, explicit scope/freshness/provenance, named section and Review details drawer. Details are inspection only, not editor mutation, clipboard or Grafana publish.

components.name: Button / CopyButton / Textarea / GlassPanel / PanelTitle / Text / Code
components.contract: Controlled 14-row monospaced editor with native text selection and localized accessible name. Copy uses exact trimmed text and shared stale-attempt invalidation. Copy and Clear are disabled for whitespace-only drafts. Retain shared focus/typography/theme/density contracts.

components.name: OrderedStepList / InlineCallout / EmptyState / FadeIn
components.contract: All three passive draft/copy/paste steps, manual-push disclaimer, localized clipboard success/warning/danger. InlineCallout non-action branch role=status. Catalog empty branches preserved although constants are nonempty. FadeIn delegates reduced-motion preferences.

components.name: AINLGrafanaPanel / AIFeatureCard / AiOutputPanel / withAiFeature
components.contract: Preserve feature gate, prompt, contextual Ask Helix label, streaming disabled/busy state, preview title/type/datasource/target-count/referenced-table list, explicit Apply, output/error/activity/usage. These existing shared owners must not be replaced by page-local AI controls.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Frontend manually mirrors backend whitelist names, UIDs and column identities. Descriptions differ but identifiers/counts match the inspected catalog. Page comments point to an obsolete handler filename.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain all entries now; coordinate catalog metadata generation/ownership if another consumer establishes a shared need. Correct references during an authorized change, not by inventing a catalog endpoint.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Three catalog renderers repeat bordered low-chrome list cards with differing content. One-page audit does not establish need for a new universal catalog component.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Prefer existing primitives and local typed renderer extraction only if useful; preserve nested column lists and datasource UID details.

sourceStrategy: Editor/workflow and panel-type/datasource grids stack until xl, then 2+1 columns: page 37,332-333,417-418.
Panel-type list uses 1/sm 2/3xl 3 columns; table catalog auto-fits min(100%,18rem): page 440,512.
min-w-0/max-w-full, wrapping actions/column rows, identifier overflow-wrap:anywhere and p-4/sm:p-5 retain readable content without intentional mobile deletion: page 334,352,447,483,527.

issues.detail: Viewport-driven sm and xl grids can be cramped inside a reduced allocated shell width; several catalog PanelTitle rows lack wrapping unlike editor/workflow headings. This is a source risk, not observed overflow.
issues.fix: Test ten contract widths, narrow allocated container, long translations/identifiers, RTL and 200% text; keep every catalog entry, column and action reachable.

responsive.runtimeStatus: Unverified; no browser, viewport, drawer scrolling, overflow or touch-target measurements.

sourceStrengths: Editor and AI prompt have localized aria-labels; Textarea forwards native controls and generated stable IDs/focus tokens.
All direct page icons have aria-hidden; catalogs are semantic nested ul/li lists rather than inaccessible visual matrices.
OperationalBrief section uses aria-labelledby; Review details opens existing Drawer with title/description/status.
Clipboard callouts use role=status; AI error output uses role=alert; contextual Ask Helix action exposes disabled and aria-busy.
Shared FadeIn suppresses entrance motion when useMotionPreference requests reduction.

issues.detail: Editor has an accessible name but no associated visible label/help or aria-describedby linking manual-copy/propose-only guidance. AI prompt similarly supplies aria-label without associating surrounding description.
issues.fix: Associate existing localized guidance using Textarea label/hint or explicit stable IDs/described-by. Preserve exact input and workflow semantics.

issues.detail: AI Apply uses size=sm, as do shared Ask Helix and Review details controls. Effective 44px touch reachability, focus restoration and real screen-reader announcements are not measured.
issues.fix: Validate real open/closed drawer and AI states on mobile/keyboard; coordinate density/target changes with shared owners if measurements demonstrate a gap.

accessibility.runtimeStatus: Keyboard, screen reader, target sizes, effective contrast, forced colors and reduced-motion runtime unverified.

states.manualEditor: Available regardless of AI; blank editor is valid, not missing fleet data. Copy/Clear disabled for whitespace-only text, which remains persisted. Edit/clear/apply reset clipboard status; storage denial is silently ignored.
states.catalog: Static reference explicitly identified in summary, freshness and provenance; three empty fallback branches exist but are unreachable with current nonempty constants.
states.settings: Default AI off/empty flags hides optional AI section while manual content survives; no distinct page notice differentiates disabled AI from unavailable settings.
states.ai: Idle prompt; streaming busy/disabled; output text/activity/usage; done with no text shows no-output message; error uses alert; draft stays separate until Apply. New generation clears prior candidate, whereas page editor remains intact.
states.clipboard: Success instructs manual Grafana paste; unavailable API warning and rejected write danger both preserve editable text and allow manual copy/retry.
states.offlineStalePartial: Static catalogs and already-restored editor do not represent live/stale/offline measurements. Shared settings/stream own network behavior; no page-owned DataState or automatic Grafana readiness signal.

issues.detail: localStorage write/remove failures are swallowed, so long-draft persistence is best-effort although explanatory comments imply navigation safety.
issues.fix: If authorized, disclose persistence unavailability non-destructively through existing feedback, retaining in-memory input and manual copy. Never claim durable save without success.

visualIssues.detail: Repeated fixed cyan/emerald text decorates ordinary catalog identifiers, UIDs and columns; five cyan section icons add another accent layer. Three list surfaces use bg-white/[0.02]. No literal neon/glow or pure-white text was found in page source, but fixed colors and white-alpha surfaces remain theme/visual-noise risks.
visualIssues.fix: Use restrained primary/secondary/muted and surface tokens for ordinary metadata; reserve subdued semantic accent for actual meaning. Measure composed light/dark contrast; do not reset persisted theme IDs or remove catalog detail.

visualIssues.detail: Shared Ask Helix overrides outline button chrome with repeated cyan border/background/text/focus classes; page-specific AI preview also uses cyan border/background. These compete with the restrained neutral catalog treatment. Saturation/glow/effective contrast were not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Coordinate restrained shared CTA/preview tokens without changing Ask Helix contextual names, streaming feedback, opt-in or explicit application. Do not create a competing page-local variant.

architectureIssues.detail: Page describes canonical datasource UIDs but backend explicitly calls them placeholders requiring user adjustment. Static catalog presence must not imply live installation/connectivity or Grafana-ready import compatibility.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain explicit static-reference provenance; clarify UID adjustment/compatibility limitations in existing localized guidance during an authorized integration change.

architectureIssues.detail: Parser comments promise strict whole-draft rejection, but malformed targets are dropped and missing targets become []; grid positions accept nonfinite numbers. Page serializes the narrowed snake_case envelope without a proven translation to Grafana native JSON fields.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate typed parser/backend/export-contract tests before changing mapping. Preserve all valid target fields and raw editor text; do not claim validation or import equivalence from a successful tool event.

architectureIssues.detail: Static catalog English descriptions render directly, outside t(), while surrounding titles/workflow/errors are localized. Source column/type/UID identifiers are intentionally technical and must remain unchanged.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize descriptive prose through existing catalogs with stable identifiers as keys; retain SI names, types, PII notes and all 33 column descriptions.

priority.rationale: Working source-level manual workflow already uses existing foundations and explicit static trust. Highest risks are UID/import/parser trust boundaries, then metadata color/localization and mobile/open-state verification. No runtime failure is claimed.
order: Resolve source-backed compatibility/trust limitations without adding automatic push.
Coordinate shared AI chrome and preserve all explicit review/application behavior.
Subdue page metadata/surfaces and localize prose.
Run actual ten-width, theme, keyboard, drawer and offline/error acceptance under parent validation ownership.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Restrained shared AI CTA and output/preview presentation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing outline CTA, canStart/stream/onAction, busy/disabled/focus, inputSlot, children and AiOutputPanel state/text/error/activity/usage; retain localized contextual aria-label.
usedBy: Other AIFeatureCard callers require owner inventory; not audited here
dependsOn: AI feature owner and central visual acceptance
requiredSharedChanges.status: Report-only shared-owner coordination; no new primitive or global styling edit authorized.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Grafana typed draft/catalog compatibility and truthful reference guidance
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: GrafanaPanelDraft/onApply, draft_grafana_panel tool-result parser, datasource UID placeholders, targets/ref_id/raw_sql/grid_pos, valid/invalid/partial candidate and explicit apply.
requiredSharedChanges.status: Do not change auth, execute SQL, call production Grafana, or introduce a push/proxy capability.

relatedButNotEquivalent: Manual and optional AI workflows intentionally coexist; AI proposes, user applies and copies.
No iframe, embedded dashboard, proxy URL or Grafana connection action exists in the inspected page/component trace. Do not invent one because of the route name.
competingImplementations.limits: One-page trace only; no app-wide search for other Grafana surfaces or claim that deployment proxies are absent.

actions.name: Edit/paste JSON
actions.behavior: Arbitrary raw text; persist verbatim and reset status; do not silently parse, execute or recase.

actions.name: Copy to clipboard
actions.behavior: Only nonwhitespace; copy trimmed string, leave editor/persistence intact; shared pending-attempt invalidation and manual-copy recovery.

actions.name: Clear
actions.behavior: Disabled for blank/whitespace, otherwise empty editor, remove storage key and clear status. Do not silently change this existing default.

actions.name: Review details and close
actions.behavior: Inspect catalog provenance and counts; drawer close must retain editor/storage and never invoke clipboard or Apply.

actions.name: Ask Helix / Draft panel
actions.behavior: Opt-in only, trimmed prompt, clear previous candidate at new request, streaming guarded.

actions.name: Apply to editor
actions.behavior: Explicitly replace editor with JSON.stringify(draft.panel,null,2); reset status. No automatic application or Grafana push.

dataBehavior: ai.grafanaPanel.draft key/raw persistence unchanged; storage best-effort.
Reference counts remain distinct from live connectivity/database measurements.
Manual editing is independent of AI gate, provider failures and candidate state.
Preserve current preferences, route SafeRoute/lazy mounting and shell ownership; no new vehicle/date selectors.
Retain source SI identifiers and user JSON; no unit conversion, telemetry collection or auth changes.
Embedded/proxy behavior is not present in the assigned source; preserve the actual manual-copy boundary rather than inventing an embed.
